registry_rule: A numerical subtraction is allowed only when population rows, generation, labels/grader, prediction unit, metric, and score direction are explicitly matched. Published table proximity is context, not a paired comparison.

match_axis_statuses.EXACT: The cited frozen artifacts establish identity on this axis.
match_axis_statuses.COMMON_REPLAY: The comparator was recomputed on the same frozen rows under a shared local protocol, but is not claimed as an exact upstream reproduction.
match_axis_statuses.ADAPTED: The implementation or protocol deliberately differs from the published method.
match_axis_statuses.DIFFERENT: The axis is known not to match; direct subtraction is forbidden unless a separate estimand is stated.
match_axis_statuses.PARTIAL: Only part of the intended paper protocol or population is available.
match_axis_statuses.UNKNOWN: The evidence does not establish the axis.
match_axis_statuses.NOT_APPLICABLE: The axis does not apply to this comparator.
